reason: The Codex apply_patch guard under test judges destinations relative to this repository, so its symlink, move and budget fixtures have to exist inside the checkout; each test removes its fixture in a finally block.
The prepare entrypoint fixture sits below this repository so Node resolves the root TypeScript toolchain without copying or installing dependencies; each test removes its fixture in a finally block.

The configured template include requires native Vitest worker probes inside this checkout; "bounds default native Vitest workers across configured projects without changing test deadlines" removes the fixture with removeFixture in its finally block.

The relative-runDir fixture must be reachable by a relative path from the test's cwd, and on a Windows runner the os temp dir sits on another drive than the checkout; "is unknown when the armed flag’s runDir is a relative path — never resolved against the doctor’s own cwd" removes it with removeFixture in its finally block.
